messages:
incidentbot: PAGING — sev2: routing fallback loop detected in eu-west-1 causing elevated 503s for Dedicated pool. Alert: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.2% to 11.8% across routing-proxy nodes. Trigger: 503 rate threshold (10%) crossed.

maya: seeing it in Grafana. A subset of routing-proxy pods are returning 503s immediately after kernel optimization rollout (kernel-opt v2). Traffic is partially failing over but fallback is oscillating.

samir: I'm oncall, taking it. Maya — quick handoff: what mitigations did you try?

maya: quick list:
- cordoned 3 unhealthy routing-proxy pods (nodes 12/13/14)
- shifted 30% of traffic to backup region (us-west-2) via smart-router policy
- temporarily disabled aggressive prefix caching (to avoid stale KV hits)
- not rolled back yet because we wanted to see if traffic stabilizes after cordon+drain

samir: thanks. On it. First priority = restore customer success for Dedicated customers. Can you paste the command you used to scale traffic?

maya: sure, ran:
```bash
# natively via router-admin
router-admin route adjust --pool dedicated-eu --shift 30% --to-region us-west-2 --tag incident-1769456789
```

samir: executing rollback plan for kernel-opt v2 on routing nodes. I'm going to trigger the rollback for the kernel-opt daemonset and then force a serial restart of routing-proxy to avoid simultaneous warm-start KV cache misses.

samir: running rollback now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout undo daemonset/kernel-opt -p revision=kernelex-2026-03-10
kubectl -n routing rollout restart deployment routing-proxy --strategy=serial
```

incidentbot: Action recorded: rollback initiated by samir at thread_ts 1769456825.

lee: Heads up from Support — two Dedicated customers reported errors: "AcmeRetail" (ticket #SUP-4421) and "FinTide" (#SUP-4423). Both reported intermittent 503s since ~19:02 UTC. Customer impact: request failures for inference endpoints, retry clients hitting backoff.

maya: estimated affected QPS at peak ~125 req/s per customer, overall impacted tokens ~120k tokens/min across pool. SLA exposure flagged; CC'ed enterprise CS.

samir: rollback completed on kernel-opt; watching metrics.

incidentbot: Metric update: 5xx rate dropping — 11.8% -> 3.2% in 6 minutes.

samir: forcing cache rewarm for restarted pods to re-populate KV prefix cache:
```bash
# warm a small set of hot prefixes
for p in $(cat hot_prefixes.txt); do curl -s https://routing-proxy/internal/warm?prefix=$p & done
```

incidentbot: Mitigation progress: fallback oscillation reduced; 5xx rate now 0.4% — below threshold. Automated paging will resolve.

maya: confirmed hotspot nodes are stable. I've left the backup shift in place (30%) for the next 30m while we validate. Will coordinate with infra to validate kernel-opt artifacts before any re-apply.

samir: summary for handoff => Resolved state: rollback applied, traffic shifted to backup, caches rewarmed. Customer impact: AcmeRetail and FinTide experienced intermittent 503s ~19:02–19:12 UTC, business impact moderate, no data loss, retries mitigated most customer errors.

samir: next steps (we should capture these into a postmortem and action tracker):
- ACTION 1: Root-cause investigation: confirm kernel-opt v2 change introduced request path regression (owner: diana, due: 2026-03-18).
- ACTION 2: Rollout gating: add a preflight synthetic that exercises routing-proxy hot paths (owner: maya, due: 2026-03-17).
- ACTION 3: Autoscaler safety: add circuit-breaker to prevent simultaneous restarts during daemonset changes (owner: lee, due: 2026-03-25).
- ACTION 4: Customer communication follow-up: CS to send impact summary and mitigation steps to AcmeRetail/FinTide (owner: chris (CS), due: 2026-03-15).
- ACTION 5: Runbook update: document step-by-step mitigation (owner: samir, due: 2026-03-16).

diana: I'll pick up ACTION 1 and host the RCA deep dive. I'll need logs from kernel-opt CI and kernel versions from affected nodes — tagging infra and kernel-team.

chris: I'll draft the customer impact email and coordinate with legal for any SLA notice. Will send initial outreach within 2 hours.

maya: for ACTION 2 — proposal: synthetic should do a warm-start path plus KV cache invalidation test. I can sketch the test harness and share repo link.

samir: scheduling: propose a 60m postmortem meeting tomorrow 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC. Diana to own slides + timeline.

diana: confirmed, I'll create calendar invite and attach preliminary timeline + incident timeline. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/pmr-1769456789 (placeholder).

chris: also proposing a brown-bag for org-wide learnings — short 45m session focusing on "routing fallback and rollout safety patterns". Suggested date: 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC. Speakers: diana (RCA), maya (test harness), lee (autoscaler safety).

maya: I'll prep a short demo of the synthetic harness and a checklist for rollouts.

lee: I'll prepare the autoscaler/circuit-breaker design notes and a quick runbook snippet.

samir: wrapping up handoff — marking incident as mitigated. I'll open the postmortem doc, populate timeline + logs we collected, and link action items to the org tracker.

incidentbot: Incident state change: MITIGATED by samir at 1769457900. Postmortem doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/pmr-1769456789 (placeholder).

maya: final note — let's also add a small continuous synthetic that runs per-region after kernel/infra rollouts; prevent blind rollouts in high-traffic pools.

chris: noted. I'll include a sentence in the customer follow-up that we're doing a postmortem and will share learnings + remediation timeline.

lee: leaving this thread open for action updates. I'll take ownership of tracking ACTION 3 in the sprint board.

samir: thanks everyone — great mitigation. I'll post the postmortem link here once Diana finishes slides.

diana: created the postmortem doc and assigned initial owners in the action table. Invite sent.

chris: customer outreach sent for AcmeRetail/FinTide. cc: samir, diana, maya.

incidentbot: Thread closed for new pages. All key mitigations logged.
